title: Journal API
summary: Persist and query journal events. Complements depend on this API.
configure: None. This is the storage contract other journal plugins call.

sections.heading: How complements call it
paragraphs: journal-admin, journal-email and journal-cron declare dependsOn journal-api >=1.0.0. They call application helpers, never journal-api http/ or infrastructure/. getPluginService("journal-api") is the documented service lookup. Disable journal-api and the complements are not effectively enabled.
